Container.Name: OMP
Container.Overview: oh-my-pi (omp), the subagent-and-model-roles fork of pi, with the Cody browser UI (github.com/nphil/cody, the ompweb successor). Cody spawns omp --mode rpc-ui as a child process and shares its filesystem, so agent and UI live in this one container by necessity. Lives at its own address 192.168.1.75 on br0 (reserve it in the UDM): web UI on :30177, and SSH on :22 straight into the omp TUI (quit omp to get bash; the login behavior is /data/home/.bash_profile, which is user data). SSH is key-only against /data/home/.ssh/authorized_keys unless OMP_SSH_PASSWORD is set below; host keys persist in /data/ssh. The web UI has real HTTP Basic Auth: CODY_PASSWORD is required (the container refuses to start without it) and the username is always cody. Image is version-tracked automatically at github.com/nphil/pi (omp/ directory): a scheduled workflow watches npm for omp releases and the nphil/cody repo for new commits, then pushes a fresh :latest to GHCR, so this app shows an ordinary update in the Docker tab; Apply Update recreates from this template. Runs as nobody:users with passwordless sudo; the container is the sandbox (no docker socket, not privileged, one quota-capped mount), and root-level setup that must survive updates goes in /data/on-boot.sh. Internal only: LAN and tailnet, never exposed publicly. Model roles live in /data/home/.omp/agent/config.yml; providers in models.yml (seeded from models.json on first run). Log in to Claude and ChatGPT with /login inside the TUI, then point the default, slow and plan roles at them.
Container.Requires: llama-swap on :9292 for the local worker roles. Reserve 192.168.1.75 in the UDM's DHCP so nothing else takes it. This template is the canonical container definition; Apply Update recreates from it.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Everything: omp state (home/.omp/agent: models.yml, config.yml, auth.json, sessions), home + SSH authorized_keys, SSH host keys (ssh/), and the agent workspace (workspace/)

Config.Name: CODY_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Required. HTTP Basic Auth on the web UI and every API endpoint; the username is always cody. The container refuses to start without it.

Config.Name: OMP_SSH_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Optional. Set to allow SSH password login for the omp user; empty keeps SSH key-only (authorized_keys in /data/home/.ssh).
